zh: 我会留意找的。
en: I'll keep an eye out for it.
note: keep an eye out for + 东西：一边走一边留意找

zh: 走过去最多三分钟。
en: It's no more than a three-minute walk.
note: no more than：最多、不超过；a three-minute walk：步行三分钟的路程

zh: 走过去应该五分钟左右。
en: You should be able to walk there in five minutes, give or take.
note: give or take：放在数字后面，表示「左右」

zh: 我都清楚了，不用再说了。
en: I think I'm all set.
note: I'm all set：我都好了，不需要别的了；也可以回答店员「还要什么吗」

zh: 谢谢，不过我真得走了。
en: Thanks, but I've really got to get going.
note: I've got to = I have to；get going：动身、出发

zh: 抱歉，我这周六要出去旅行，所以没时间去爬山。
en: Sorry, I'm going on a trip this Saturday, so I don't have time to go hiking.
note: go on a trip：去旅行；don't have time to + 动词原形；爬山说 go hiking

zh: 我约了医生。其实我有点头疼。
en: I have a doctor's appointment. Actually, I have a bit of a headache.
note: a doctor's appointment：约了看医生（别漏 a）；头疼说 have a headache，不说 my brain is pain

zh: 要不我们下周六去爬山？我很想跟你一起去。
en: Maybe we can go hiking next Saturday? I'd love to go with you.
note: can 后面用原形：can go；I'd love to…：我很想……，婉拒后提出别的时间

zh: 结婚以后，把我们俩公寓的东西搬过来，应该就够了。
en: After we're married, we'll just take the things from each of our two apartments and that should do the trick.
note: do the trick：管用、能解决问题；That should do the trick. 这样应该就行了

zh: 那就只剩客厅了。
en: That just leaves the living room.
note: leave 这里是“剩下”：That leaves…… 那就剩……了，可换词：That just leaves one question.

zh: 我本来只是想赶回家看下午的比赛。
en: I was just hoping to get home in time for the game this afternoon.
note: I was just hoping…：我本来只是想……（委婉抱怨）；in time for：及时赶上某事（≠ on time 准时）

zh: 几个月前他在公司没被提拔。
en: He was passed over for a promotion at work a couple of months ago.
note: be passed over for a promotion：升职时被跳过，别人升了他没升（不是他自己放弃）；a couple of months：几个月

zh: （听完对方讲的原因）难怪会这样。
en: That would do it.
note: That would do it：那就说得通了、难怪；对别人讲的原因表示理解，不是“那会做它”

zh: 我对什么都烦透了。
en: I'm fed up with everything.
note: be fed up with…：受够了、烦透了；可换词：I'm fed up with my job.

zh: 别绕弯子了，直接告诉我。
en: Don't beat around the bush. Just tell me.
note: beat around the bush：说话绕圈子、不说重点；催对方说重点时整句可用

zh: 我原来也这么想，可谁说得准呢。
en: I thought so, too, but you never know.
note: you never know：世事难料、说不准；表达不确定，不是“你永远不知道”

zh: 他搬进来的时候，我想跟他闲聊几句。
en: I tried to shoot the breeze with him.
note: shoot the breeze：闲聊、随便聊聊；平时聊天就能用

zh: 你是做哪一行的？
en: What line of work are you in?
note: line of work：职业、行当；比 What's your job? 更自然

zh: （说他可能干坏事）我看他还真干得出来。
en: I wouldn't put it past him.
note: I wouldn't put it past sb：某人真做得出这种事（多指坏事）

zh: 我觉得我们还是少管闲事吧。
en: I think we should just mind our own business.
note: mind one's own business：管好自己的事，别多管闲事

zh: （坚持邀请或要求）我可不接受拒绝。
en: I'm not taking no for an answer.
note: not take no for an answer：不接受别人说“不”，非要做到不可

zh: 老板从来不用担心我偷懒。
en: The boss never had to worry about me slacking off.
note: slack off：偷懒、松懈；worry about sb doing：担心某人做某事

zh: 没想到，我还挺喜欢团队合作的。
en: To my surprise, I liked working in a team.
note: to my surprise：让我意外的是，放在句首讲出乎意料的事

zh: 我从不用担心有事情被漏掉。
en: I never need to worry that things will fall through the cracks.
note: fall through the cracks：被疏忽、被漏掉（不是真的掉进缝里）

zh: 我们知道什么时候该主导，什么时候该退一步。
en: We know when to take charge and when to back off.
note: take charge：负责、主导；back off：退让、不插手

zh: （面对一大堆选择）哇，我真不知道从哪儿开始。
en: Wow, I really don't know where to begin.
note: where to begin：从哪里开始；面对很多选择或很多事情时都能用

zh: 有一点要注意：有些音乐网站是专属格式的。
en: One thing you have to watch out for is that some music websites are proprietary.
note: One thing you have to watch out for is…：有一点要注意的是……；watch out for：留意、提防

zh: 这正是我担心的。
en: That's what I'm worried about.
note: That's what I'm worried about：这正是我担心的，回应别人时很自然

zh: 这正是我一直在找的。我买了。
en: It looks like what I've been looking for. I'll take it.
note: what I've been looking for：我一直在找的东西；I'll take it：买东西时说“就要这个了”
